description: Flavor Meister is your joyful digital recipe box — one that remembers how you felt about every dish. Whether it’s a beloved casserole, a five-star curry, or a new recipe you’re unsure about, this tool helps you store, rate, and tag meals by mood, flavor, ingredients, and more.
